note: Draft rho_reference descriptor for VALIDATION.json (docs/VALIDATION_GATE.md); not VALIDATION.json itself.
scope: Headline cell: torsion family (cofactor 4, 6 curves), log2#E = 40, best IC arms ic-b and ic-c2 against matched rho-neg, 2 IC targets and 8 rho targets a curve.

kind_by_family.torsion: negation (rho-neg; Aut = {+-1}, j not in F_p by the trace test)
kind_by_family.prime: negation (rho-neg; Aut = {+-1}, j not in F_p by the trace test)
kind_by_family.gls: negation_frobenius (rho-psi: classes {+-P, +-psiP}, psi the twisted p-power Frobenius). Only ic-gls-psi / rho-psi is against the strongest available reference; the README's GLS rows ic-gls-neg / rho-neg and ic-gls-psi / rho-neg are not. j = 0 (an order-6 automorphism, a larger fold) is not excluded by the trace test for: ['fp2-gls-b24-i0-p4027'].

protocol: PROTOCOL.md 'Decision rule (frozen)': matched rho of the family, rho-neg (Van Oorschot-Wiener on {P, -P}, r-adding walk, 16 jumps below 2^30 and 32 above, distinguished points with floor(log2 r / 4) bits, one addition a walk start, short-cycle escape by doubling, answer verified) for ic-a, ic-b, ic-c1, ic-c2, ic-gls-neg; rho-psi for ic-gls-psi
unit: GAE (group-addition equivalents). IC: counted F_p multiplication equivalents (inversion = 4) divided by c_add, the measured mult-eq of one affine addition on the same curve (24 at inv-cost 4). Rho: counted group additions plus doublings, 1 GAE each. Unpriced native operations of every arm priced at w GAE each (w = 0, 0.1, 1).
binary_or_process: One process per curve: each torsion-b40-i{0..5}.jsonl came from a single invocation of the card-built binary target/blindspots-01/card-NN/b01 run with --arms 'ic-a:0-1,ic-b:0-1,ic-c1:0-1,ic-c2:0-1,rho-neg:0-7' (cards 05, 06, 07). Every card built that binary with the same rustc command from examples/blindspots_01_fp2_gaudry.rs sha256 0629a73c7ff443e70c6ce16c0872b98a5aebc5a71d25f7bff60156c8693ff559, verified at each receipt's commit; the file now lives byte-identically at research/blindspots_20261018/instruments/blindspots_01_fp2_gaudry.rs. The binary's own sha256 was not recorded (each card deletes it).
band_cost_definition: Mean over the 6 torsion curves of the per-curve mean total cost per verified solve, GAE, gae_priced + w * native_total; the ratio of these is the protocol gap.
best_arm_note: ic-b is cheaper than ic-c2 at w = 0 and dearer at w = 0.1 and 1 (ic-b < ic-c2: [True, False, False]), so by AGENTS.md 5a the two are unresolved against each other. ic-c2 is shown because it is best at two of three weights and has the smallest ratio in the band; the IC-vs-rho order holds for both arms at every weight.

evidence.matches_protocol: raw rows: arm rho-neg, fold 2, 8 targets on each of the 6 curves, all verified; argv per card
